sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests state power over presidential electors. Colorado claims it can remove electors who break their pledge. Baca claims this violates the Constitution. The Court must decide if states hold this removal authority.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: Colorado wants the power to remove electors who break their pledge.
Baca wants the Court to strike down the state removal rule.

sections.heading: What each side says
paragraphs: Colorado argues states have plenary authority to remove electors who betray the people.
Baca argues state rules are too rigid and lack necessary exceptions.
